title: The Cake with Walnuts
那塊核桃蛋糕
paras: Greta Fischer was the {{organizer|organizer}} of the yearly {{banquet|banquet}} for the Children's Hospital Foundation, a {{charitable|charitable}} group that pays for toys, books, and equipment on the children's ward. The dinner would seat two hundred guests. The old train station downtown made a lovely {{venue|venue}}, and the {{caterer|caterer}}, Mr. Bianchi, had worked with her for three years. Everything was ready.
葛蕾塔．費雪是兒童醫院基金會年度晚宴的籌辦人。這個基金會是慈善團體，出錢替兒童病房買玩具、書和設備。晚宴要招待兩百位賓客。市中心那座舊火車站是個很棒的場地，餐飲承辦商畢安奇先生也已經跟她合作三年了。一切都準備好了。

At {{noon|noon}} on Friday, the day before the event, Mr. Bianchi called. "Greta, I just read your final guest list. Twelve people have a nut {{allergy|allergy}}, and tomorrow's {{dessert|dessert}} is a walnut cake." Greta closed her eyes. The menu had been printed a month ago.
活動前一天，週五中午，畢安奇先生打電話來。「葛蕾塔，我剛看完你最後的賓客名單。有十二個人對堅果過敏，而明天的甜點是核桃蛋糕。」葛蕾塔閉上眼睛。菜單一個月前就印好了。

"Don't worry," he said. "We {{cater|cater}} to guests with allergies all the time. I'll make a lemon tart for everyone, no extra charge." Then he added, "Bring your volunteers by the kitchen at one. I'll feed them {{sandwich|sandwiches}} before they set up the tables."
「別擔心，」他說，「有過敏的賓客，我們一向都能照顧到。我會替所有人改做檸檬塔，不加價。」接著他又說：「一點帶志工來廚房吧，他們布置桌子之前，我請他們吃三明治。」

The next evening, the guests loved the tart. During the auction, a local bakery owner stood up and promised to {{donate|donate}} a thousand dollars to the children's ward, and others followed. By ten o'clock, the night had raised more money than any before it. Greta found Mr. Bianchi in the kitchen and thanked him twice.
隔天傍晚，賓客都很喜歡那款檸檬塔。拍賣時，一位當地烘焙坊老闆站起來，承諾捐一千美元給兒童病房，其他人也跟著響應。到了十點，這晚籌到的款項比以往任何一場都多。葛蕾塔在廚房找到畢安奇先生，向他道了兩次謝。
